census.note: Classes come from the read-only census of 2026-11-11 recorded in solve/epics/system-table-retention.md. Change a class only with the landed code or ruling that justifies it.

partitions.reason: One row per partition; rows of a split or merged parent are removed by the split/merge path.

services.reason: Cleanup tombstones are released by a guarded DELETE through gateway.submitMutation; the model for propagated tables.

replica_operations.reason: Propagated; one row per ADD/REMOVE/REPLACE, whole row rewritten per step, never deleted (removeReplicaOperation has no caller). Row size is carried first by retention-step-history-observation-removal.

indices.reason: The index row is deleted when the index is dropped.

logs.reason: Not propagated; LogsTableService bounds only its in-memory queue and LogRetentionService is not imported by anything in src.

live_queries.reason: No production writer found by the 2026-11-11 census; the owner decides whether to delete the table or name its writer.

contexts.reason: No production writer found by the 2026-11-11 census; the owner decides whether to delete the table or name its writer.

code.reason: No production writer found by the 2026-11-11 census; the owner decides whether to delete the table or name its writer.

control_plane_publications.reason: Propagated; one row per membership epoch and node boot with transition_history JSON; removePublication has no caller.

schema_migrations.reason: One row per migration, never deleted.

schema_migration_partitions.reason: One row per migration and partition, never deleted.

service_instances.reason: One row per service instance; deletion is forbidden, a missing row is CORRUPT_STATE.

service_bindings.reason: One row per binding, never deleted.

service_endpoints.reason: Endpoint rows are removed by primary key when the endpoint is withdrawn.

service_timers.reason: No production writer found by the 2026-11-11 census; the owner decides whether to delete the table or name its writer.

service_packages.reason: One row per package, never deleted.

service_revisions.reason: One row per revision, never deleted.

service_installations.reason: One row per installation, never deleted.

service_install_failures.reason: One row per failed install, never deleted.

module_manifests.reason: One row per module manifest, never deleted.

package_registry_mappings.reason: No production writer found by the 2026-11-11 census; the owner decides whether to delete the table or name its writer.

package_registry_overrides.reason: No production writer found by the 2026-11-11 census; the owner decides whether to delete the table or name its writer.

module_dependency_locks.reason: No production writer found by the 2026-11-11 census; the owner decides whether to delete the table or name its writer.

wasm_operations.reason: The 24 h window is only a read-side refusal; rows stay.

sql_transactions.reason: Propagated; never deleted; scanned in full every second by the recovery sweep.

sql_transaction_participants.reason: Propagated; never deleted; scanned in full every second by the recovery sweep.

schema_operations.reason: Classed bounded by nature by the 2026-11-11 census; not independently verified.

debug_sessions.reason: One row per debug session, never deleted.

debug_breakpoints.reason: One row per breakpoint, never deleted.

debug_snapshots.reason: One row per debug snapshot, never deleted.

storage_reservations.reason: Propagated; one row per storage-increasing operation; status only moves to released or expired.

service_partition_access.reason: Classed bounded by nature by the 2026-11-11 census; not independently verified.

call_cell_reduce_slots.reason: Expired slot rows are reclaimed past the retention window.

call_cell_reduce_results.reason: Abandoned empty results are reclaimed; published rows stay.

call_activation_leases.reason: Classed bounded by nature by the 2026-11-11 census; not independently verified.

artifact_payloads.reason: Reclaimable UPLOADING rows have no reclaim code.

artifact_payload_chunks.reason: Chunks of UPLOADING payloads have no reclaim code.

_cdc_obligations.reason: D1 reclamation: position-based delete inside apply; the model for partition-internal tables.

_partition_statement_outcomes.reason: One row per committed statement in every partition, carried in snapshots; no DELETE exists.

_participant_transactions.reason: One row per participant transaction in every partition; no retirement.
